rows: When the visual asks, per filter

blocks.code:
Sales = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )
Cost = SUM ( Sales[Cost] )

GP % = DIVIDE ( [GP], [Sales] )
AR = SUM ( AR[OpenAmount] )

GP % (VAR) =
VAR s = [Sales]
VAR c = [Cost]
RETURN DIVIDE ( s - c, s )

pages.intro: Every number in a visual is calculated under filters. CALCULATE changes those filters.

blocks.body: Filter context: the slicers, rows and columns that decide which rows a measure sees. Row context: 'the current row' inside a calculated column or SUMX.

blocks.code:
Sales Co 1000 =
CALCULATE ( [Sales], Company[Code] = "1000" )

Sales Export FY2026 =
CALCULATE ( [Sales],
  Customer[Type] = "Export", 'Date'[FY] = "FY2026" )

blocks.note: 'Sales Co 1000' ignores the Company on each row.

blocks.code:
% of Total =
DIVIDE ( [Sales],
  CALCULATE ( [Sales], ALL ( Company[Code] ) ) )

pages.key: CALCULATE is the most important DAX function: it runs a measure under changed filters.

pages.tip: ALL vs ALLSELECTED? ALL ignores every filter on the column; ALLSELECTED respects the user's slicer choice.

RANKX ( ALL ( Customer[Name] ), [Sales], , DESC, DENSE )

blocks.code:
Sales LY =
CALCULATE ( [Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )

Growth % =
VAR c = [Sales]  VAR p = [Sales LY]
RETURN DIVIDE ( c - p, p )

CALCULATE ( [Sales],
